messages:
Marta: Quick kickoff 2 I'm building the webinar landing + a compact battlecard: focus = benchmarks -> buyer path -> inbound routing. Need a 60s field pitch vs managed cloud endpoints and a routing matrix for leads. Draft here: https://tinyurl.com/rwdb-webinar-draft
Devon: Good. Also want a 30s SMB vs Enterprise rebut for 'we already use managed endpoints'. Keep it punchy.
Ken: Two measurable diffs: predictable unit economics (reserved/dedicated) and routing/fallback that avoids outages. Can we include a safe range (30-60% unit-cost improvement) as long as legal clears it?
Aisha: Landing CTAs: 1) "Request benchmark" -> Bench SDR queue, 2) "Book demo" -> AE. Add microfield: "primary use case (chat/embeddings/generation)" for routing. I'll map HubSpot workflows.
Riley: Battlecard one-liners (for SDRs):
- Buyer: "We use CloudX managed endpoints"
  SDR: "Totally. Redwood preserves your dev API while giving predictable capacity and fallbacks. Want a 1hr bench vs your profile?"
- Buyer: "We can't run infra"
  SDR: "No problem 2 start Hosted, move to Dedicated when needed. We handle the ops or keep it for you."
Devon: Post-webinar email (short):
Subject: Redwood bench offer
Hi {{name}},
Thanks for joining. Want us to run a short bench on your workload? We'll share latency + unit-cost deltas and a routing rec.
Schedule: [link]
Marta: Bench narrative: use "real app workloads" phrasing, 2-3 sequence profiles, emphasize batching + cache impact. Ken -> confirm ranges and legal-safe blurb by EOD.
Ken: Will confirm numbers; will include "results vary by model, prompt length, and workload shape" note.
Aisha: Routing matrix: tag CTA + keywords. If CTA=benchmark or message contains "latency"/"benchmark" -> Bench SDR (high). If CTA=demo or contains "SLA"/"enterprise" -> AE. Region-based routing for EMEA/APAC. I'll post workflow IDs.
Riley: I'll draft 6 two-line play scripts (SDR & AE) under 140 chars for copy/paste.
Marta: Action items: Ken (numbers/legal), Aisha (HubSpot routes), Devon/Riley (scripts). I'll assemble landing + battlecard and circulate.
ops-bot: created ticket #482 routing-draft and assigned to Aisha.
Devon: :thumbsup:
Marta: Thanks, will update when merged.
